instruction: Use EAGLE CAM/export commands for the manufacturing files and desktop archive/text applications only for packaging and the README. Start EAGLE from `/opt/eagle-7.7.0/bin/eagle` and open `blinker.brd` there. Using `blinker.brd`, create a manufacturing-output zip named `/home/user/Desktop/answer.zip`. Requirements: 1. `/home/user/Desktop/answer.zip` must be a readable ZIP archive. 2. It must contain at least 6 Gerber files using the suffixes `.gtl`, `.gbl`, `.gto`, `.gbo`, `.gts`, and `.gbs`. 3. It must contain at least 1 drill file with suffix `.drl`, `.drd`, `.xln`, or `.nc`. 4. It must contain `README.txt`. 5. Every Gerber file must be non-empty, begin with `G04`, `G75`, `G70`, `G71`, `G01`, `G02`, `G03`, or `%`, include an RS-274X format statement (`%FS...*%`) and unit statement (`%MOIN*%` or `%MOMM*%`), and end with `M02*`. At least one Gerber in the set must include both an aperture definition and coordinate draw/flash commands. 6. Every drill file must be non-empty and contain an Excellon `M48` header, at least one tool definition and coordinate, and an `M30` terminator. 7. `README.txt` must mention every Gerber and drill filename in the archive.
